card.text: M103 is an open star cluster in the Milky Way, about 2,527 parsecs away.

sources.quote: Messier 103 is a small open cluster of many faint stars in Cassiopeia.

introduction.text: M103 is drawn as 209 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.
